headline.zh: TSLA 周一大涨 11.46%，但合并仍无公告；SpaceX 新添两州 Grok 诉讼
headline.en: TSLA jumps 11.46% on Monday, but still no merger announcement; SpaceX faces two new state Grok lawsuits

summary.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月 24 日（亚洲/新加坡），Tesla 与 SpaceX（SPCX）仍没有已宣布或已交割的合并，也没有换股比例或正式协议，两家公司过去一天没有新的官方表态。已确认的仍是：10 月 20 日马斯克确认两家公司成立独立董事特别委员会，条款未定、不保证达成；彭博 11 月 12 日「最早 12 月宣布、也可能推迟到 2027 年初」仍属传闻。过去 24 小时的变化主要在市场与风险两端：美国周一 TSLA 收涨 11.46% 至 385.46 美元，报道归因于 FSD v15 推送、SpaceX 收购预期（汇丰 507 美元情景、Cathie Wood 的溢价说法）和英伟达恢复黄仁勋 CEO 职务后的大盘反弹；SPCX 收涨约 4.4% 至 133.35 美元。同日弗吉尼亚州与俄勒冈州就 Grok 深度伪造内容起诉 SpaceX、X 与 SpaceX Super Intelligence。马斯克在 X 上称特斯拉内置 Starlink 希望明年年底前后推出、但中国除外，没有谈合并。
summary.en: As of 24 November 2026 (Asia/Singapore), Tesla and SpaceX (SPCX) still have no announced or closed merger, no exchange ratio and no definitive agreement, and neither company made a new official statement in the past day. What is confirmed is unchanged: on 20 October Musk confirmed both companies formed independent-director special committees, with no agreed terms and no guarantee of a deal; Bloomberg's 12 November report of an announcement as soon as December or slipping to early 2027 remains a rumor. The past 24 hours brought changes in the market and in risk: on Monday TSLA closed up 11.46% at $385.46, which reports attributed to the FSD v15 rollout, SpaceX-takeover hopes (HSBC's $507 scenario, Cathie Wood's premium comments) and a broad rebound after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO; SPCX closed up about 4.4% at $133.35. The same day Virginia and Oregon sued SpaceX, X and SpaceX Super Intelligence over Grok deepfake content. On X, Musk said built-in Starlink for Teslas is hoped for toward the end of next year, except in China, and did not discuss the merger.

points.zh: 事实状态不变：过去 24 小时没有合并公告、监管文件或权威媒体新独家；新增报道多是对股价上涨的解读与评论。
points.en: Facts unchanged: in the past 24 hours there was no merger announcement, regulatory filing or new scoop from a major outlet; new coverage was mostly explanation of the stock move and commentary.

points.zh: TSLA 周一 +11.46%（385.46 美元），但驱动因素是混合的：FSD v15、合并预期和大盘反弹（Investing.com 称纳指 +6.9%）。不能把整段涨幅都算作合并溢价。
points.en: TSLA +11.46% on Monday ($385.46), but the drivers were mixed: FSD v15, merger hopes and a broad rebound (Investing.com cited Nasdaq +6.9%). Not all of the gain should be read as merger premium.

points.zh: SpaceX 法律与政治风险上升：弗吉尼亚、俄勒冈两州 11 月 22–23 日就 Grok 起诉 SpaceX 等公司；此前 Himes 11 月 20 日致信质疑 SpaceX 政府合同。SpaceX 国防业务与特斯拉中国业务仍是两大监管难点，马斯克本人也说 Starlink 在中国「非法」。
points.en: Legal and political risk at SpaceX is rising: Virginia and Oregon sued SpaceX and affiliates over Grok on 22–23 November, after Himes's 20 November letter questioning SpaceX government contracts. SpaceX's defense work and Tesla's China business remain the two main regulatory hurdles, and Musk himself says Starlink is 'illegal' in China.

points.zh: SPCX 侧：Investing.com 报道 Jefferies 11 月 23 日首次覆盖 SpaceX，给予买入评级、目标价 210 美元；同文提到 12 月 8 日内部人士禁售期到期可能带来抛压。这些是单一来源报道，未见公司确认。
points.en: On the SPCX side: Investing.com reported that Jefferies initiated SpaceX on 23 November at Buy with a $210 target, and noted an insider lock-up expiring on 8 December as a possible supply overhang. These are single-source reports, not company confirmations.

points.zh: 特斯拉侧需要全部已发行股份至少 50% 同意；特斯拉 2026 年股东年会定在 12 月 3 日，公开报道称合并不在投票议程上。
points.en: On the Tesla side, at least 50% of all shares outstanding must approve; Tesla's 2026 annual meeting is on 3 December, and published reports say the merger is not on the ballot.

tsla_analysis.zh:
美国 2026-11-23（周一）TSLA 收于 385.46 美元，较前收 345.82 美元上涨 39.64 美元（11.46%），盘中最高 393.83 美元；基本收复上周五 7.64% 的跌幅，仍略低于 11 月 13 日的 390.22 美元。同日 SPCX 收于 133.35 美元（+约 4.4%）。卖方方面没有新的 TSLA 评级可核实，最近的仍是汇丰 11 月 20 日上调至 Hold、目标价 359 美元（33% 收购溢价情景 507 美元与独立 DCF 212 美元等权）；现价已高于该目标价。若价格中包含被收购溢价，谈判推迟、条款不及预期或监管受阻（国会对 SpaceX 政府合同的审查、新的州诉讼、中国审批）时，这部分可能回吐。

期权方面，OptionCharts 显示 11 月 23 日 TSLA 期权成交约 192 万张（认购约 112 万、认沽约 80 万），成交量认沽/认购比 0.71，未平仓认沽/认购比 0.78；30 日隐含波动率约 49.8%，较 11 月 20 日一年高点 63.35% 明显回落，IV Rank 约 49；按 7 日隐含波动率，市场定价一周约 ±6.5%（约 ±25 美元）的波动。对卖出看跌期权而言，股价大涨叠加 IV 回落意味着同一行权价的权利金比上周五低。没有可独立核对、且与合并一一对应的期权大单明细。以上是公开资料的摘录，不是对价格或波动率的预测。
tsla_analysis.en:
On Monday 23 November 2026 TSLA closed at $385.46, up $39.64 (11.46%) from $345.82, with an intraday high of $393.83, largely recovering Friday's 7.64% drop but still slightly below the 13 November close of $390.22. SPCX closed at $133.35 (up about 4.4%). No new TSLA rating change could be verified; the latest remains HSBC's 20 November upgrade to Hold with a $359 target (equal weight to a $507 value at a 33% takeover premium and a $212 standalone DCF), which the stock now exceeds. If the price embeds a takeover premium, it could unwind if talks slip, terms disappoint or regulators push back (congressional scrutiny of SpaceX government contracts, the new state lawsuits, Chinese approval).

In options, OptionCharts shows about 1.92 million TSLA contracts traded on 23 November (about 1.12 million calls, 0.80 million puts), a volume put/call ratio of 0.71 and an open-interest put/call ratio of 0.78; 30-day implied volatility was about 49.8%, well down from the one-year high of 63.35% on 20 November, with IV rank around 49; 7-day implied volatility prices a one-week move of about ±6.5% (about ±$25). For put sellers, the rally plus lower IV means less premium at the same strike than on Friday. There is no independently verifiable options-flow detail tied specifically to the merger. This summarizes public sources and is not a forecast of price or volatility.
